coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Exclude donation drives, resource guides, recipes, opinion, routine promotions/distributions, generic inflation, older incidents, duplicates and non-U.S. events.
coverage_notes.assessment: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption verified in the observed interval after 12 usable targeted searches and 6 usable direct-source checks. Two direct endpoints were inaccessible; supplementary coverage remained useful but is incomplete. Absence of a finding is not proof of nationwide absence.
